maxGapDays.description: Optional maximum difference of session-local dates; must be at least minGapDays

granularity.description: Copied from the template when the event is created; later template edits do not change it

maxGapDays.description: Optional maximum difference of session-local dates; must be at least minGapDays

minGapDays.description: Minimum difference of session-local calendar dates; zero permits the same day

changed.description: Assignment changed relative to the previous publication

events.description: Events overlapping [from, to); empty when no assignments exist

timeZone.description: Authenticated person's IANA display time zone, e.g. Europe/Moscow

expectedInputVersion.description: Session input version to check; a mismatch returns 409

PrecheckResponse.description: Basic diagnostics, not a proof of infeasibility; issues do not block launching a solver

incompleteData.description: Collection is still open or some participants have not submitted

PublishVariantRequest.description: Whole-variant publication only. Both confirmation flags must be explicitly supplied, even when false; they never override hard constraints.

confirmStaleData.description: Must be true when the input snapshot is stale

confirmUnassigned.description: Must be true when the variant contains unassigned events

expectedRevision.description: Opaque revision returned by GET, compared atomically before replacement

ScheduleCommissionMemberResponse.description: Public commission identity; chair distinguishes the chairperson from other members

ScheduleConstraint.description:
S1: same-day teacher gaps in minutes; S2: maximum minus minimum commission workload in minutes across the entire commission pool, including zero workloads; S3: personal busy overlap minutes for each affected participant, multiplied by importance coefficient MEDIUM=3, LOW=1, or CRITICAL=10 for a student in a GROUP event; S4: same-day teacher room transitions between in-person events (count); S5: events changed in time, room or commission from the baseline (count). These five soft constraints form P; unassigned events U are compared independently before P.

Подробнее: [Мягкие ограничения S1–S5](https://github.com/vk-ab-schedule/slotwise-doc/blob/main/MODEL.md#мягкие-ограничения).

ScheduleMetrics.description: Metrics recomputed by the common domain validator. Compare (U, P) lexicographically: minimize unassignedEvents U first, then penalty P at the same U. A lower P cannot beat a lower U. Null penalty/bestBound/gap mean unavailable, not zero. Bounds and gap concern only P at the reported U. OPTIMAL requires proof of both minimum U and minimum P at that U. NO_SOLUTION does not prove infeasibility; FEASIBLE does not prove optimality.

bestBound.description: Proven lower bound on soft penalty P at the reported U only; does not prove minimum U; null when unknown

commissionLoadRangeHours.description: Maximum minus minimum commission workload in hours across the entire commission pool, including teachers with zero commission workload; excludes examiner and supervisor workloads

commissionLoadStandardDeviationHours.description: Standard deviation of commission workloads in hours across the entire commission pool, including teachers with zero commission workload; excludes examiner and supervisor workloads

gap.description: Relative gap for P to bestBound at the reported U only (fraction, not percent); does not prove minimum U; null when unknown

penalty.description: Validated soft penalty P, the sum of S1-S5 weighted penalties; null if no solution was obtained

scoreComponents.description: Exactly one component for each S1-S5, including zero penalties; their weighted sum is P

solveStatus.description: OPTIMAL requires proof of both minimum U and minimum P at that U; FEASIBLE does not prove optimality; NO_SOLUTION does not prove infeasibility

teacherRoomChanges.description: Number of same-day teacher room transitions between in-person events (S4)

unassignedEvents.description: Unassigned-event count U; minimized before soft penalty P

undesirableEvents.description: Number of events overlapping soft personal busy time: MEDIUM, LOW, or CRITICAL student busy time in GROUP events

ScheduleParticipantResponse.description: Public participant identity and role in this event, not an account profile

ScheduleRoomResponse.description: Display information for a physical room or the unlimited online platform

building.description: Physical building; null for an online platform

ScoreComponent.description: One of five soft-constraint contributions to P; weightedPenalty = rawPenalty * weight. Raw units are minutes for S1-S2, personal busy overlap minutes multiplied by importance coefficients for S3 (MEDIUM=3, LOW=1, CRITICAL student in GROUP event=10), and counts for S4-S5. Hour-based summary metrics are reported separately; unassigned events U are compared independently before P.

roomChangeBufferMinutes.description: Room-change buffer in minutes; default is 15

slotMinutes.description: Server-chosen model parameter in minutes, currently 5; informational and not editable in requests

baseVariantId.description: Optional baseline variant from the same session; preserves its locked assignments

seed.description: Explicit signed seed; negative values are valid

supportsBestBound.description: Whether the algorithm can report a proven soft penalty P bound and gap at the reported U; these do not prove minimum U. OPTIMAL requires proof of both stages.

SolverJobFailure.description: Technical failure without stack traces or private participant data

SolverJobResponse.description: Execution lifecycle is separate from solveStatus: COMPLETED + NO_SOLUTION is valid, with no result variant and no technical error. All polling fields are present, including nulls.

error.description: Sanitized technical error for FAILED; null for NO_SOLUTION

progress.description: Fraction in [0, 1], or null when the solver cannot estimate progress

queuePosition.description: One-based position while queued; null outside the queue

resultId.description: Result variant ID; null before completion or when no solution exists

solveStatus.description: OPTIMAL, FEASIBLE or NO_SOLUTION on normal completion; otherwise null

UniversityDemoDataset.description: Профиль синтетического набора для демонстрации и проверки планировщика. Администратор выбирает его в поле dataset запроса POST /api/admin/demo-data. Для воспроизводимости набора в запросе также передаётся seed.

post.description: ORGANIZER owner only. Snapshots input at expectedInputVersion; a version mismatch is 409. May run before collection closes; such results are marked incomplete and retain missing respondents. Reuses an identical request for the same session, input version, algorithm and parameters; if the session already has an active calculation, returns that job. Otherwise queues a job with its queue position. Any signed seed is valid. Optional baseVariantId must belong to this session; its assignments provide the baseline for S5 and its locks enforce H9. Poll getSolverJob for progress. Completion creates a validated draft when a solution exists; it never publishes automatically. A time limit without a solution is NO_SOLUTION, not a proof of infeasibility or a technical failure.

get.description: ORGANIZER owner only; inaccessible variants return 404. Returns every assignment, including UNASSIGNED events, both variant and assignment versions, locks, participant names, resources, commissions, metrics, input provenance and basic explanations. Metrics come from the shared validator, not a solver's self-evaluation. Explanations are limited precheck diagnostics and do not claim a unique cause. Stale data and missing respondents are explicit. FEASIBLE does not claim optimality; bound and gap are null when unknown.

patch.description: ORGANIZER owner only, DRAFT variants only. Supplies the complete editable assignment, including explicit locked and commissionMembers, and checks expectedVariantVersion and expectedAssignmentVersion; concurrent changes or an immutable variant return 409. ASSIGNED requires start/end, the selected physical room or online platform, and a valid commission. Times are UTC instants on 5-minute boundaries, end follows start and duration matches the event. UNASSIGNED clears times/resource/commission. The same domain validator checks H1-H9 and recomputes (U, P) with S1-S5 and preparation days H10: hard violations return 422 with issues and never persist. dryRun=true returns a preview, metrics and affected account IDs without changing either version. Saving atomically changes the assignment and variant versions. Locking enforces H9 in later solves; it does not publish. A conflicting lock is never silently removed.

post.description: ORGANIZER owner only. Publishes the entire validated DRAFT variant atomically and marks the previous publication SUPERSEDED. No subset of assignments can be selected. Checks expectedVersion (409 on a concurrent edit). Hard violations block publication with 422, regardless of confirmation flags. confirmUnassigned and confirmStaleData must both be explicitly supplied; each must be true when the corresponding condition exists, otherwise 422 reports the required confirmation. Unassigned events remain visible to the organizer. Repeating publication of the current published variant has no additional effect. Participants see only the current publication; published assignments cannot be edited.
